reuse.why: Follows the existing assert-before-link pattern in accounts/app.ts and uses db.first like the existing assertion; there was no existing closed-account check to reuse.

duplication.why: The check is defined once; the only repetition is one call line per provider handler, mirroring how the existing availability assertions are wired.

placement.why: The assertion sits next to assertBankAccountIsNotLinked in app.ts and runs in the handlers before any link work, as the tree does for the other link precondition; link.ts would also have been a fit.

scope.why: Only the new assertion, its six call sites and two focused tests.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow, but a new provider handler must remember to add two assertion calls since there is no single guard wrapping the link handlers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the same per-handler assertion structure the tree already has.

one_place.where: assertAccountIsOpenForBankLink in accounts/app.ts, called by all six *-accounts-link handlers.
